description:
Andy Serkis explains why Animal Farm feels relevant in a post-truth world shaped by social media, misinformation, and uncertainty. In this Heroes Journey Podcast clip, Serkis discusses truth, trust, kids growing up today, and why his Animal Farm adaptation is designed to start important conversations while still offering hope.

author: CBR
description:
Chadwick Boseman’s Black Panther debut changed the MCU, and the directors explain why his performance as T’Challa was impossible to replace.

The filmmakers reflect on Chadwick Boseman’s impact 10 years after his Black Panther debut in Captain America: Civil War. They describe Boseman as the only choice for T’Challa and explain how he brought elegance, intensity, and “fierce regality” to the role. Boseman also helped shape the character’s world, including the accent and the specific cultural identity behind his performance.

This quick Marvel breakdown looks at why Chadwick Boseman’s Black Panther became iconic so quickly, how he gave T’Challa ownership and depth, and why the MCU’s version of Black Panther would not have worked the same way without him.
